chunks: 阿米尔穆米宁（愿主福安之）说："遗嘱人若公正无私，不损害他人，则如同其在生前施舍者。"
ai.seo_question: what is the legal ruling on a bequest that is not unfair or harmful to heirs
ai.summary: attributed to imam al sadiq as quoting imam ali as this hadith clarifies that a bequest made without encroaching on heirs rights or causing them harm is treated as if the wealth was gifted during the testator lifetime this distinction is crucial in shia jurisprudence for determining whether the bequest is deducted from the one third share or considered an additional gift thereby preserving the heirs fixed portions it underscores the ethical imperative of fairness in posthumous wealth distribution
